huldra: A huldra, shown from a three-quarter rear angle: a beautiful woman in a woollen dress from the front, but with a LONG COW'S TAIL and a BACK THAT IS HOLLOW LIKE A ROTTED TREE TRUNK, bark-textured inside, glancing back
huma: A huma bird in flight, a magnificent long-winged bird with flowing plumage in gold, green and deep blue, an elegant crested head, LONG TRAILING TAIL FEATHERS, wings fully spread, drawn as never having landed, no feet visible
ifrit: An ifrit, a towering jinn of SMOKELESS FIRE, the body formed of dark smoke and molten orange cracks like cooling lava, curved horns, glowing white eyes, arms crossed, the lower body trailing away into smoke
ijiraq: An ijiraq, a shifting Arctic figure that is never fully seen, part caribou and part human, its FACE BLURRED AND UNFIXED as if seen from the corner of the eye, antlers, long limbs, edges dissolving into snow-glare
ilomba: An ilomba, a thick water snake with a HUMAN FACE set into the front of its head, the face calm and recognisably a person, olive-brown scales with a pale belly, coiled in shallow water, deeply unsettling
jengu: A jengu, a water spirit with dark skin and VERY LONG WAVY BLACK HAIR flowing around her, a warm smile showing a PROMINENT GAP BETWEEN THE FRONT TEETH, a fish tail below the waist in blue and silver, cowrie shells in her hair
jerseydevil: The Jersey Devil, a lean bipedal creature with the HEAD OF A HORSE, LEATHERY BAT WINGS, cloven hooves, a long forked tail and short clawed forearms, dark grey hide, rearing with wings half spread, screaming
jiangshi: A jiangshi, a stiff upright corpse in QING DYNASTY OFFICIAL ROBES AND CAP, arms held rigidly straight out in front, greenish-white mottled skin, long claws, a YELLOW PAPER TALISMAN HANGING OVER ITS FACE, hopping
jorogumo: A jorōgumo, a woman from the waist up and a GOLDEN ORB-WEAVER SPIDER below, with long black-and-yellow banded spider legs, silk trailing from her hands, a patterned kimono over the human half, eight small eyes on her brow
kamapuaa: Kamapua'a, a huge black boar with bristled shoulders and upcurved tusks, EIGHT EYES arranged in rows across its broad face and EIGHT STOUT LEGS, tufts of fern and grass caught in its coarse coat, steam at the nostrils
kamuyhuci: Kamuy Fuchi, an ancient Ainu grandmother of the hearth, deeply lined kind face with traditional tattoos around the mouth, white hair, robes with Ainu geometric patterns, seated with HEARTH FLAMES RISING AROUND HER
kapre: A kapre, a very tall dark-skinned hairy giant seated cross-legged, smoking an ENORMOUS CIGAR with a glowing tip, glowing red eyes, a wide belt, relaxed and amused, isolated figure with nothing behind it
kasaobake: A kasa-obake, an old torn paper umbrella with ONE LARGE EYE in the centre of its canopy, a LONG RED TONGUE hanging from a wide grinning mouth, hopping on a SINGLE SANDALLED FOOT, bamboo ribs visible through the paper
knocker: A knocker, a tiny wizened miner no taller than a boot, wrinkled brown face with a huge nose, a leather cap with a candle stub stuck to it, carrying a little pick, coal-dusted clothes, a knowing sideways look
korpokkur: A korpokkur, a tiny person sheltering UNDER AN ENORMOUS BUTTERBUR LEAF held like an umbrella, wearing small Ainu robes with geometric embroidery, dark hair, holding out a fish as an offering, shy and half-hidden
lamiak: A lamia of the Basque rivers, a woman with long hair seated by the water COMBING IT WITH A GOLDEN COMB, and with the WEBBED ORANGE FEET OF A DUCK below her skirt, river stones around her, a sly friendly look
likho: Likho, a gaunt towering figure in tattered black, skeletally thin, with a SINGLE EYE in the centre of a hollow face, long grasping fingers, hunched and leaning forward, an air of exhausted inevitability
lilith: Lilith, a striking dark-haired woman with LARGE FEATHERED OWL WINGS and the TALONED FEET OF AN OWL, standing upright, two owls at her feet, drawn in the flat style of a Mesopotamian relief, calm and unafraid
lusca: A lusca, an enormous octopus with vast muscular arms and a huge mottled mantle, rust-brown and pale grey, ONE ENORMOUS EYE prominent, arms coiling upward out of dark blue water, suckers clearly visible
manananggal: A manananggal, a woman SEVERED AT THE WAIST with only the upper body flying, LARGE BAT WINGS from her back, ENTRAILS TRAILING BENEATH her cut torso, long black hair, a long thin proboscis tongue, pale and hollow-eyed
